tasks.short: Offer advice on a particular security.

steps.what: Pull the quote and the client's written limit.
Offer advice on the purchase or the sale.
Sign the advice note of what was said.

tasks.design: The quote and the client limit are on one {CRM} screen, with the price from the market terminal ({OTHER}). The agent offers the advice on the call. The signed note in {DOCS} records what was said. A draft sentence is not the advice, and it is not sent on its own.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice was a call with no note, so later nobody could see what was actually recommended.
tasks.enabler_now: The quote and the limit can sit beside the note. They do not choose the recommendation.
tasks.still_hard: Suitability for this client is the advice, and a diploma duty is not met by a drafted sentence.
tasks.human_edge: The agent gives the advice and signs the note. Nothing in the pack is allowed to recommend a purchase or a sale.
tasks.altitude: The advice stays the agent's call. The change is a signed note of what was actually said.

reach.task: advise on a particular policy and sign the note
reach.learn: which sentence is the advice and which is only a quote

evidence.claim: The job digest leaves securities advice with the person. A screen of the quote is not the advice.

The job digest says securities advice stays with the person, and advising staff need a diploma. A draft is not the advice. The job digest says order-related calls and messages are kept for five years, and up to seven, even when no trade follows.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: The task is the advice conversation and the note. Placing the order is another task.

Fields: client id, instrument id, quote, limit, advice text, talk date. The agent writes the advice text. The quote comes from the market terminal. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: The {CRM} already holds the client and the limit. The build shows them beside the note. It does not add a recommendation engine.
The signature is the record of the advice. Any edit voids it. The task adds no call recording and no seller score.
unknowns: Whether this client is retail, and so inside the diploma duty.
Whether the firm already requires a written suitability note.
research_questions: What share of advice calls has no note today?
How often does the client act against the advice?

already_counted.description: The agent still gives the advice on the call.
The agent still signs the note.

incremental.description: Keep the note headings aligned with the house advice policy.

approvals.approved_version: advice-note v1: client-id, instrument, quote, advice-text, talk-date

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the advice is still a long call, the note is the only saving, and a disputed recommendation still has to be rewritten by the agent.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List prospects who already opted in.
Contact prospective customers and explain the services.
Log what the prospective customer asked next.

tasks.design: The {CRM} holds prospects who already opted in, with the date and the channel of that opt-in. The agent contacts them and explains the services. The call stays with the agent. No machine places the call. The outcome is logged on the same record.
tasks.previous_blocker: The list mixed people who had opted in with people who had only visited a page, so the agent could not see which call was allowed.
tasks.enabler_now: An opt-in is a field with a date. Filtering the list on that field is configuration, not a new dialler.
tasks.still_hard: The call itself, and whether the person is interested, stays with the agent.
tasks.human_edge: The agent makes the call and hears the answer. A list cannot present the firm's services.
tasks.altitude: The calls stay on the agent's day. The list no longer includes people who have not opted in.

reach.task: call a prospect about a first conversation
reach.learn: which opt-in field must be present before the call

evidence.claim: Filtering a prospect list on an opt-in field is configuration. The call stays with the agent.

The job digest says that since 1 July 2026 calls to consumers, zzp and vof need a prior opt-in, existing customers included. Calls to a bv or nv may state name, firm and purpose. A machine caller would have to say it is a machine. This task does not use one. The job digest says call recording and scoring of sellers need works-council consent. This task adds neither.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: The task is the prospect call. Advice and an order are other tasks.

Fields: person id, opt-in date, opt-in channel, phone, firm type. The list includes a row only when opt-in date is filled for a consumer, zzp or vof. The agent types the outcome. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: The {CRM} already stores contacts. The build filters on the opt-in field. It does not add a dialler.
No call recording and no seller score are added. A missing opt-in drops the row rather than calling.
unknowns: Whether the firm's current list stores opt-in date.
Which prospects are consumers rather than a bv or nv.
research_questions: What share of today's calls has no recorded opt-in?
How often does a call turn into advice on the same call?

already_counted.description: The agent still makes the call.
The agent still logs the outcome.

incremental.description: Keep the opt-in filter aligned with the call rules.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If most of the day is still the call, the list filter saves the sorting and the refused numbers, not the conversation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain stock market terms to clients.

steps.what: Show the approved card for stock market terms.
Explain trading practices, or hand the client off.
Add a missing term the client asked about.

tasks.design: Approved term cards live in {DOCS}, each with a source. A question that matches a card is answered from that card, and the reply says when a machine showed it. When the question becomes advice, the agent takes it. A new card is signed before it can be shown. The desk does not invent a definition.
tasks.previous_blocker: Terms were explained from memory, and a wrong sentence had no source to check.
tasks.enabler_now: A known term is approved text. Matching a question to a card is configuration. Advice is not.
tasks.still_hard: Clients ask for a recommendation in the same breath as a definition, and that part cannot be a card.
tasks.human_edge: The agent takes the question the moment it is advice, and signs any new card.

ambition.what: Answer a term question from the approved card for smaller clients as well, the same day it is asked.

tasks.altitude: The agent stops repeating definitions that already have a card, and still takes every advice question.

reach.task: explain a fare rule from the published text
reach.learn: which question is still the text and which one a person must take

evidence.claim: The job digest puts explaining on an answer desk over approved documents, with a handoff when it becomes advice.

The job digest says an answer desk uses approved text and hands off when the question becomes advice. From 2 August 2026 a chat that is a machine must say so. A public chatbot was held to a wrong fare, so this desk does not invent a sentence.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: The task is explaining terms and trading practices. A recommendation to buy or sell is the advice task.

Fields: question text, card id, source, term. The card text is the approved source. A question with no card goes to the agent. A new card needs the agent's signature. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: The helpdesk already takes questions. The build matches them to cards. It does not add a second site.
A machine reply must say it is a machine. Any edit to a card voids the old approval. No seller score is stored.
unknowns: Whether clients ask in chat, on the phone, or both.
Who may approve a new term card besides the agent.
research_questions: What share of questions matches a card?
How often does a term question become advice?

already_counted.description: The agent still explains what the card does not cover.
The agent still approves a new card.

incremental.description: Keep the card list and the handoff rule current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If most questions are really advice, the card saves only the plain definitions and the agent still takes the call.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Calculate costs for billings from the rate table.
Calculate commissions from the same rate table.
Sample the billing batch before it is posted.

tasks.design: Billing costs and commissions are calculated from the rate table in {SPREADSHEET}: trade id, rate, amount and account, then posted toward the {ERP}. The agent samples the batch and signs that version before anything is posted. A row with no rate is left out and listed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Costs were worked on a side sheet, so a rate change was applied to some trades and not others.
tasks.enabler_now: A cost or a commission is the rate times the base. That is code. The sample is the person's check.
tasks.still_hard: A special rate agreed on a call may not be in the table, and the agent still has to enter it.
tasks.human_edge: The agent signs the batch and catches a rate the table should not apply. The arithmetic does not decide the exception.

ambition.what: Sample the billing batch every day it runs, including quiet days that used to be posted unseen.

tasks.altitude: The agent stops recalculating clean rows and still signs the batch.

reach.task: calculate a fee from the published schedule
reach.learn: which rate field the total must match before it is posted

evidence.claim: The job digest treats cost sums and price requests as rules on a rate card. A missing field goes back to the agent. No model sets the price.
Posting a commission is internal arithmetic. It is not a seller score, and the job digest says seller scoring would need works-council consent. This batch stores no score.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: The task is the calculation and the sample. Collecting the cash is another task.

Fields: trade id, account, base amount, rate id, rate, billing amount, commission amount. Rates come from the rate table. A trade with no rate is excluded. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: The rate table and the ledger already exist. The build calculates and blocks a post of an unsigned batch. It does not add a second ledger.
The signature covers that version of the batch. A rate edit voids it.
unknowns: Whether a special rate is allowed without a second signature.
research_questions: What share of rows has no rate?
How often does the sample find a wrong rate?

already_counted.description: The agent still samples and signs the batch.

incremental.description: Keep the rate table and the exclusion list current.

approvals.approved_version: billing-batch v1: trade-date, trade-ids, rate-ids, amounts

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If many trades use a special rate that is not in the table, the agent still prices those by hand and the saving is only the standard rows.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The agent keeps the advice and the prospect call. Term cards and commission arithmetic leave the hour.
reach: Travel agent: answer a fare question from the published card, and learn when the question has become a booking.
Insurance sales agent: call only people who already opted in, and learn which sentence must not be said by a script.
skills_to_grow: Tell a term question from a request for advice.
Read a commission row back to the rate table before it is posted.
role.ambitious_version: A client who asks a market term gets the approved card the same day, and advice still waits for the agent.
